Types.Name: PersistedValue
Types.Summary: Finite binary64, UTF-8 strings, dense arrays or string-keyed maps; no nil, metatables, cycles or host objects. D21 bounds: depth 16; 1,024 entries/table, 4,096 expanded entries; 64 KiB envelope; 16 KiB strings; 128-byte map keys. Runtime validation is authoritative.

Members.Name: IsDependencyAvailable
Members.Summary: Check the exact declared dependency binding.

Members.Name: Register
Members.Summary: Register a bounded command with optional permission and description.

Members.Name: GetAsync
Members.Summary: Committed-only non-yielding read submission. Later callback receives fresh value/nil, nil/nil for absence, or nil/ErrorCode. Immediate return means acceptance only; rejected calls owe no callback. D21 keys: 1..128 UTF-8 bytes; 8 pending/namespace, 128 globally; 5-second request deadline. Private owner required; retirement suppresses delivery.

Members.Name: RemoveAsync
Members.Summary: Committed-only irreversible removal. Later true/nil means removed, false/nil means absent; nil/ErrorCode means failure, possibly Indeterminate. Immediate return means acceptance only; no rollback, replay or guaranteed delivery after retirement.

Members.Name: SetAsync
Members.Summary: Committed-only irreversible write; bounded snapshot before acceptance. Later true/nil follows durable commit and validated response; nil/ErrorCode is failure. Indeterminate may have committed. No rollback or automatic replay; stale callbacks are suppressed.

Members.Name: GetDataStore
Members.Summary: Disk-free private store acquisition, allowed during publication; exact current admission must match resource owner. D21 store names: 1..64 UTF-8 bytes; 64 distinct names/domain. No success or I/O implied.
